solution:
The man the girl loved betrayed her today; he was packing his bags, preparing to move out of the apartment they shared.
The girl tearfully begged him not to leave, but he did not look back.
Just then, the girl said coldly, "At least leave my pillow behind."
And so, she cut off the boy's hand.

canonical_facts: The woman and the man were romantic partners sharing an apartment.
The man betrayed her that day and was preparing to move out.
She begged him to stay, but he continued leaving.
She said, "At least leave my pillow behind," then deliberately severed his hand.
proposed_interpretation: Pillow refers to the partner's body part used as a headrest, not an ordinary cushion. The excerpt uses arm while the supplied final answer says hand; equivalence for grading requires confirmation.
explicit_negatives: The severing was not an accident.
The pillow in the intended twist was not simply an ordinary stuffed cushion.
